text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ruby. I'd like to give<n>you a gift. Is
there anything you<n>want?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... Your well-wishes are more<n>than enough. I
sincerely appreciate<n>them.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Really? It's your birthday though. I'dlike to get something.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about a hair accessory?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The other day I saw some things<n>finely crafted out
of glass. I thought<n>something like that would suit
you...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you probably already have so<n>many
accessories that are better<n>quality. Sorry, I'll think
of—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I mean, I wouldn't refuse... a hair<n>accessory.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Great. I'll pick out something<n>special for you
then.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you... Though, don't go to too<n>much trouble.
